messages:
harper (Finance Ops): FYI — NimbusAI reported two March invoice PDFs. One PDF is missing the 'Reserved GPU hours' line (~$1,980). The other is a duplicate but shows CAD amounts. Both were emailed. Need a quick triage; auditors asking for corrected doc.

invoice-bot: alert invoice_service job-13001 retried (reason: storage PUT timeout). tasks: job-13001 / job-13001-retry.

diego (Billing Eng): looking now. I see job-13001 and a retry 11s later. Retry ran with TRANSIENT_RETRY=true which skipped dedupe/validation. Probable partial read of usage blob during retry.

rachel (Revenue Ops): Customer message: "INV-2026-0379.pdf (no reserved hours) and INV-2026-0379-copy.pdf (CAD amounts). Which one should we record?" They asked for corrected invoice + credit note.

sam (Accounting): Approve re-issue and credit note. We need corrected PDF before EOD. Include original filenames and a short reason in the footer. VAT must be applied (they provided VAT id).

kai (Support): I'll tell the customer ETA and pause auto-capture for their account until corrected invoice is sent. :pray:

diego (Billing Eng): Plan: 1) patch generator to never skip dedupe on retries; 2) wait for usage-aggregator commit marker before reading usage; 3) add pre-send validation to BLOCK if expected line items (usage>0) are missing; 4) re-run job-13001 with validation enforced and issue CN-2026-0088 referencing duplicate file. ETA ~3h once patch lands. Creating BILL-1610.

harper (Finance Ops): Good. Please don't re-email until pre-send validation passes. Also add a canned CS message: "We mistakenly sent duplicate invoice PDFs due to an internal retry; please use the corrected invoice and attached credit note."

diego (Billing Eng): will do. tagging @eng-sre on the ticket for storage consistency follow-up. I'll update this thread when reissued.

harper (Finance Ops): Thanks everyone. Add RCA + remediation to BILL-1610 for the monthly billing postmortem. :eyes:
